## Claims
- [source-backed] For \(m\ge1\), the source takes \(n=4m\), \(r=n-r=2m\), \(i=j=m\), hence \(a=b=m\), but states that \(J_v\) requires \(\binom{2m}{m}\) generators only “according to Conjecture 4.10.” [doi:10.1090/s0002-9947-2010-05163-3, lines 938-955]
- [proved] Let \(A_m=H^\star(GL_{4m}/B,\mathbb Z)\), \(v_m=v_{2m,2m,m+1,4m}\), and let \(w_m\) be the unique dissector partner of \(v_m\). Then
  \[
  J_{v_m}^{A_m}=I_{w_m}^{A_m},\qquad
  \mu_{A_m}(J_{v_m}^{A_m})=\mu_{A_m}(I_{w_m}^{A_m}),
  \]
  where \(\mu_A(L)\) is the minimum cardinality of a homogeneous \(A\)-generating set of \(L\).
- [unsupported] No supplied internal theorem, with durable locator, proves
  \[
  \mu_{A_m}(J_{v_m}^{A_m})=\binom{2m}{m}\quad(m\ge1).
  \]
  The supplied primary source instead makes this numerical assertion conditional on its conjecture.

## Strategy
For \(m\ge1\), \(1\le m+1\le2m\) and \(m+1>0=2m+2m-4m\), so \(v_m\) is admissible. Its parameters are
\[
i=s-t+1=m,\quad j=r-t+1=m,\quad
a=\min(2m-m,2m-m)=m,\quad b=m.
\]

Define
\[
J_{v_m}^{A_m}:=\mathbb Z\text{-span}\{\sigma_u:u\ge v_m\},\qquad
I_{w_m}^{A_m}:=\mathbb Z\text{-span}\{\sigma_u:u\not\le w_m\}.
\]
Integral Schubert classes \(\{\sigma_u:u\in S_{4m}\}\) are a \(\mathbb Z\)-basis of \(A_m\). [doi:10.1090/s0002-9947-2010-05163-3, lines 61-66] In type \(A\), every bigrassmannian is a dissector, so the defining property of \(w_m\) is
\[
S_{4m}=\{u:u\ge v_m\}\sqcup\{u:u\le w_m\}.
\]
[doi:10.1090/s0002-9947-2010-05163-3, lines 643-648, 664-683]
Hence \(u\ge v_m\iff u\not\le w_m\). Taking the identical \(\mathbb Z\)-spans in the integral Schubert basis gives
\[
J_{v_m}^{A_m}=I_{w_m}^{A_m}
\]
as homogeneous ideals in the same graded ring \(A_m\). Therefore their homogeneous generating subsets coincide, proving equality of \(\mu_{A_m}\).

The internal snapshot also records this preservation argument and the absence of the required numerical theorem. [artifact ba093e9698dcd534de3dc53890f1b8d8396115df56ecc3710605037120fde810, lines 1-62]

## Gaps
The requested numerical premise in \(A_m\) is absent: no exact internal theorem or indecomposables certificate establishing \(\mu_{A_m}(J_{v_m})=\binom{2m}{m}\) was supplied. Thus only generator-number preservation under \(J_{v_m}=I_{w_m}\) is proved; the full requested certificate is not established.

An exact theorem or proof in the full integral coinvariant ring \(A_m\) establishing the numerical equality is required.
